name: motion-graphics-skills
description: 53 skills for motion direction, reference-led video production, animation, media preparation and timecoded review.

interface.longDescription: Plan, build and review brand films, event promos, explainers and kinetic typography with 53 skills. Includes Video Style Cloner with 36 bundled workflow modules for 2D style production, HyperFrames, media and review, plus optional Rust orchestration source. Use motion-studio for host-aware routing and motion-director for broader production. Includes Arabic/RTL, reference-fidelity gates, GSAP, Tone.js and 3D direction. Rendering requires an execution-capable host, installed dependencies and media. Rust orchestration requires project render/review adapters and an approved plan. Blender guidance is bundled but disabled in the current 2D style-cloning track. No hosted renderer or provider credentials are supplied.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 30-second Arabic brand film from my script and visual reference.
Build a code-driven motion sequence from my approved storyboard.
Review my video and give me timecoded fixes for typography, pacing and transitions.
